map_readings.label: Temporary Gate Locations Map
map_readings.shows: Map title. The map shows three grey callout boxes with green arrows marking gate locations; no other closure or deactivation symbols, and the legend lists only Constructed, Located, Streams, Adjacent Blocks, Parks & Protected Areas and Waterbody.

map_readings.label: Gate on Walbran Main - Station 11+600
map_readings.shows: Callout box with a green arrow pointing to a spot on a road at the top of the road labelled WA702, just west of the WA700 gate arrow; the road labelled WALBRAN MAIN (WA) runs from the south-west toward this area.

map_readings.label: Gate on WA900 - Station 0+372
